title: Themed message dialogs lost MessageBox's Ctrl+C copy — error text can no longer be copied anywhere in the app
existing_state: DialogTheme.ShowCore builds a plain Form with a Label and buttons (UI/DialogTheme.cs:631-750) and Confirm does the same (:535-586); neither has KeyPreview or any key handling, and Labels are not selectable. The stock MessageBox these replaced supports Ctrl+C natively (copies title + message + buttons to the clipboard). With 136 production call sites across the app now routed through DialogTheme, every error surface — SSH failures, Vault errors, config load problems, job validation messages — is an unselectable, uncopyable label. A user who wants to paste an error into a search, ticket, or chat has to retype it or screenshot it.
recommendation: In ShowCore and Confirm set dlg.KeyPreview = true and handle Ctrl+C by writing the MessageBox-style block (title, message, button captions) to the clipboard, mirroring stock behavior. Optionally add a subtle 'Copy' glyph button in the title row for discoverability. One change in DialogTheme covers all 136 call sites.
user_benefit: Restores an expected, muscle-memory capability of every Windows message box; directly useful when reporting SSH/Vault errors from fleet runs.

evidence.note: ShowCore: no KeyPreview/KeyDown, message is a Label
